knobs.name: rainT0
knobs.what: s: the first roll falls (the rain starts; HOOK ends at 12)

knobs.name: rainT1
knobs.what: s: the last of the 100,000 rolls has landed (before the count lands at 24)

knobs.name: rainWin
knobs.what: share of the 100,000 marks in the air at once (longer = slower, denser rain)

knobs.name: rainDrop
knobs.what: world units: height a mark falls from into its first-die bin

knobs.name: landAt
knobs.what: s: the count lands: '100,000 ROLLS' replaces the running counter (count.at is 24)

knobs.name: cube
knobs.what: world units: edge of one mark (one roll); must stay under pitch

knobs.name: pitch
knobs.what: world units: slot pitch of the marks in a bin or a column (scales every stack)

knobs.name: binFX
knobs.what: marks across one first-die bin (footprint width)

knobs.name: binFZ
knobs.what: marks deep in one first-die bin

knobs.name: binGap
knobs.what: world units: air between the six bins

knobs.name: colFX
knobs.what: marks across one sum column (footprint width)

knobs.name: colFZ
knobs.what: marks deep in one sum column

knobs.name: colGap
knobs.what: world units: air between the 26 columns (the streets of the skyline)

knobs.name: facesAt
knobs.what: s: the pip faces appear under the six bins

knobs.name: pinFirstAt
knobs.what: s: the six first-die counts are pinned and the a-sixth line drawn

knobs.name: pinFirstOut
knobs.what: s: the first-die pins and line leave (the crane up starts at 40)

knobs.name: sortT0
knobs.what: s: the same marks leave their first-die bins for their sum columns

knobs.name: sortT1
knobs.what: s: the last mark reaches its sum column

knobs.name: sortStagger
knobs.what: share of the re-sort spent staggering by layer (0 = all marks move at once; bottom layers first)

knobs.name: sortLift
knobs.what: world units: arc height of a mark travelling to its sum column

knobs.name: beliefAt
knobs.what: s: the equal-odds line (3,846 per sum) and its label appear

knobs.name: beliefOut
knobs.what: s: the equal-odds line leaves

knobs.name: pinColAt
knobs.what: s: peak and end pins (17, 18, 5, 30) appear in the side view

knobs.name: pinColOut
knobs.what: s: peak and end pins leave as the push into the tail starts

knobs.name: tailLitAt
knobs.what: s: the five tail columns (sums above 25) turn accent

knobs.name: pinTailAt
knobs.what: s: the five tail counts are pinned

knobs.name: pinTailOut
knobs.what: s: the tail pins leave

knobs.name: stackOut0
knobs.what: s: the 100,000 marks start to fade into the ground

knobs.name: stackOut1
knobs.what: s: the marks are gone; the counted cells take over

knobs.name: volBuild0
knobs.what: s: the counted cells start to grow (left to right by sum)

knobs.name: volBuild1
knobs.what: s: the last cell has grown

knobs.name: volCutIn
knobs.what: s (volCutIn): the cut starts travelling from sum 5

knobs.name: volCutEnd
knobs.what: s: the cut reaches the 25 | 26 edge and the tail count lands (count 2)

knobs.name: volCutTo
knobs.what: volCutTo: where the cut stops along the sum axis (stays on the 25 | 26 edge, so RIGHT = the tail count)

knobs.name: volTail
knobs.what: volTail: tail threshold on the sum axis; snapped to the 25 | 26 bin edge (lit cells sum to the tail count)

knobs.name: volCutDim
knobs.what: volCutDim: opacity of the cells the cut has passed (lower = the tail street stands out more)

knobs.name: volH
knobs.what: world units: height of the densest cell (cell height = count)

knobs.name: volZ
knobs.what: world units: depth of the six first-die rows of cells

knobs.name: volGap
knobs.what: share of a cell left as street between slabs

knobs.name: volAlpha
knobs.what: opacity of a counted cell (sorted transparency)

knobs.name: ratioAt
knobs.what: s: the ratio '= 1.7 %' appears under the tail count (always after the count)

knobs.name: insetAt
knobs.what: s: the flat inset of the 26 sums appears with the equal-odds line

knobs.name: glassT0
knobs.what: s: the exact bell (glass) starts drawing left to right

knobs.name: glassT1
knobs.what: s: the glass is complete

knobs.name: fillT0
knobs.what: s: the counted bars start to rise into the glass

knobs.name: fillT1
knobs.what: s: the counted bars are full

knobs.name: waysAt
knobs.what: s: the ways row (1 · 5 · 15 … 780 · 780 … 15 · 5 · 1) appears

knobs.name: expTailAt
knobs.what: s: '126 OF 7,776 WAYS' and expected against counted appear

knobs.name: agreeAt
knobs.what: s: the agreement lines (largest gap, mean, sd) and the mean line appear

knobs.name: volOut0
knobs.what: s: the cells start to fade (MONDAY at 108)

knobs.name: volOut1
knobs.what: s: the cells are gone

knobs.name: diceAt
knobs.what: s: the first of the five dice lands (0.4 s apart)

knobs.name: sumAt
knobs.what: s: the sum 18 appears

knobs.name: hookLineAt
knobs.what: s: the empty 5-30 axis and the flat 'anything can happen' line appear

knobs.name: hookOut
knobs.what: s: the throw fades out (the rain starts at rainT0)

knobs.name: mondayAt
knobs.what: s: the throw returns with the 14-21 band

knobs.name: countSize
knobs.what: units: the count in the display face (must-read floor 28)

knobs.name: pinSize
knobs.what: units: pinned counts in the display face (must-read floor 28)

knobs.name: subSize
knobs.what: units: lines under a count (secondary floor 14)

knobs.name: noteSize
knobs.what: units: the exact-against-counted lines in the COUNT left column (secondary floor 14)

knobs.name: insetX
knobs.what: units: left edge of the flat inset of the 26 sums

knobs.name: insetW
knobs.what: units: width of the inset

knobs.name: insetY
knobs.what: units: top of the inset

knobs.name: insetH
knobs.what: units: height of the inset (keep its bottom above the captions at 440)

knobs.name: labHold
knobs.what: frames a pin must be pushed before it hides (gl-labels hold)

knobs.name: labLeader
knobs.what: units: pin leader length (gl-labels leader)

knobs.name: litAmb
knobs.what: ambient light on the marks (higher = flatter, brighter fronts)

knobs.name: litKey
knobs.what: key light on the marks (higher = brighter tops)
